title: A knight (the combat rules' reference)
note: SANDBOX (the rules package's research-only baseline reference sheets): Strength 29, Dexterity 30, Stamina 29 as the combat rules give them; the other six Attributes 29 (ours: the rounded mean of the three, a flat profile); a knight: Melee 3, Athletics 2, Dodge 2; every Ability not listed 0. Dresses nobody by default (no role, no characters): a template for the arena and --sheet. Health from rules/harm (the engine-sandbox Health). A research fixture, not a rule.
